correctness.rationale: All positive convolution masses and neighboring ratios are explicit. Direct subtraction yields R_(k+1)-R_k=q(1-nu) S_k /((k+1)(k+2) M_k M_(k+1)) for every integer k>=1; every coefficient of S_k in k-1 is strictly positive. R_1-R_0 reduces to a single quadratic in Bernoulli odds r with root L_nu(q). The reciprocal-hazard identity compares all tail ratios for infinitely many indices, and h_0>=h_1 is exactly another monotone quadratic with root D_nu(q). At r=L the tail ratio strict comparison implies h_0>h_1, so L<D. Exact symbolic identities and rational witness are replayed by verify.py; finite tests are supplementary and not treated as proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact ageing and mass-curvature classification for a previously published count model already used in reliability discussion and biological data fitting. It distinguishes decreasing, single-peaked and increasing hazard regimes, corrects an unsupported blanket reliability interpretation, and reveals a strictly nonempty DFR-but-not-logconvex parameter band, which is not a consequence of merely spotting a failing first curvature coefficient.
